description: neroAacEnc 1.5.4.0 and neroAacTag 1.5.4.0: neroAacEnc -lc -cbr 128000 -if music-44k-stereo.wav (three times; the log does not say how the three encodes were joined); neroAacTag -meta:album="Encspect chapters"; neroAacTag -chapter:1 -meta:title="Chapter 1"; neroAacTag -chapter:2 -meta:title="Chapter 2"; neroAacTag -chapter:3 -meta:title="Chapter 3", on the synthetic source music-44k-stereo.wav.

commands: neroAacEnc -lc -cbr 128000 -if music-44k-stereo.wav (three times; the log does not say how the three encodes were joined)

input.name: music-44k-stereo.wav
input.generator: sources/make_sources.py of the sample kit (written from nothing, reproducible byte for byte)

selected_for: three chapters with titles of their own in neroAacTag's box and in the chapter list
note: The encoder stamps the time of the encode into the file; the file is committed as written, and checked by its content.
license: Nero's license limits how the software is used, not the files it writes.
